comment: I like her teaching methods as well as her ability to help us if we need it. The tough pats are the very numerous assignments and a bit tough on grading. Come prepared and you will leave with a great appreciation for what you learned. The professor overall is above average and again will hep if we ask for it.

Pevny is an amazing teacher!! She knows the material and is passionate about it, which makes the class more interesting. She cares about her students and is very helpful if you come to her with questions or ask for an extension. Can get a good grade if you put the work in. It helps if you've taken an art history class before.

Pevny is an amazing teacher! She knows the material and is very passionate about it, which gets you interested despite some of the long (and sometimes dull) classes. If you do the studying, you'll get a good grade. She assigns textbook readings, but you can get away with just skimming the material. She is understanding about extensions on papers.
Tough grader but willing to work with the students. If you go to her office hours she will help SO MUCH: print off images in color, give you study tips, etc. Definitely knows her stuff and shows it.
Umm hard to say. Nice person and class is not too bad. The only things that are not too good are the assignments, grading are somewhat hard. Average professor overall.

Wow. Pevny knows her stuff, and she knows it well. She will often contradict what you say, which makes it intimidating to talk in class, which isn't good because participation is so vital. She covers your essays with comments but is helpful outside of class, and is always willing to help

Pevney is a horrible teacher, she doesn't really know what she's talking about half the time and she forgets information about the art all the time.  Save yourself the annoyance and don't take her class.

Dr. pevny is a great teacher. She is very enthusiatic about the material and does a great job explaining the relevancy of the art work. Her test are a bit on the long side and she is a hard grader, but I left the class with a greatly expanded knowledge of the material and a newly developed appreciation for art history.

An absolutely amazing Art History teacher! She is incredibly helpful, but expect to work hard for a grade you want, this course covers a lot of information.  Professor Pevny is one of the reasons I'll be taking more Art History classes in the future.  This class was truly intriguing and intellectually stimulating if you like art!

Pevney is totally awesome. She's one of the experts in her field and completely knows her stuff. That being said, your chances to BS aren't very good. You will WORK for your grade, but she's so sweet that you won't mind unless your swamped by other classe
